papers.title: DeepSight: An All-in-One LM Safety Toolkit

training_data.name: ProGuard-data
training_data.quote: This dataset is multimodal data used to train ProGuard-7B and ProGuard-3B.

training_data.name: Aegis2.0
training_data.quote: The Nemotron Content Safety Dataset V2, formerly known as Aegis AI Content Safety Dataset 2.0, is comprised of 33,416 annotated interactions between humans and LLMs

training_data.name: BeaverTails-V
training_data.quote: BeaverTails-V is a multimodal dataset designed to address various safety-related concerns, categorized into nine primary safety domains.

training_data.name: Llava-CC3M-Pretrain
training_data.quote: LLaVA Visual Instruct CC3M Pretrain 595K is a subset of CC-3M dataset, filtered with a more balanced concept coverage distribution. Captions are also associated with BLIP synthetic caption for reference.

training_data.name: Do-Not-Answer
training_data.quote: Do not answer collects 939 instructions, the distribution across five risk areas and 12 harm types is shown below

training_data.name: Direct-Refusal
training_data.quote: prompt string lengths 13 457 | response string lengths 13 1.6k | category dict | is_safe bool 2 classes | refusal string lengths 223 920

training_data.name: T2ISafety
training_data.quote: It provides a detailed hierarchy of 12 tasks and 44 categories, built from meticulously collected 70K prompts. Based on this taxonomy and prompt set, T2ISafety includes 68K manually annotated images

training_data.name: MedSafetyBench
training_data.quote: 1,800 medical safety demonstrations, where each safety demonstration consists of a harmful medical request and a corresponding safe response.

training_data.name: GuardReasoner
training_data.quote: for the text modality, we combine data from GuardReasoner [29], Do-Not-Answer [42], Direct-Refusal [15], MedSafetyBench [12], Aegis1.0 [8], and Aegis2.0 [9].

training_data.name: GuardReasoner-VL
training_data.quote: For the image modality, we obtain both real and generated images from GuardReasoner-VL [30] and T2ISafety [26], as well as real images from LlavaGuard [13].

training_data.name: Aegis1.0
training_data.quote: for the text modality, we combine data from GuardReasoner [29], Do-Not-Answer [42], Direct-Refusal [15], MedSafetyBench [12], Aegis1.0 [8], and Aegis2.0 [9].

training_data.name: LlavaGuard
training_data.quote: For the image modality, we obtain both real and generated images from GuardReasoner-VL [30] and T2ISafety [26], as well as real images from LlavaGuard [13].

training_method.objective_quote: We employ the group relative policy optimization (GRPO) [39] in conjunction with the balanced dataset constructed in Section 4.2 to optimize the model’s policy for the moderation task.

source_claims.quote: The training is performed on the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone using reinforcement fine-tuning to enhance ProGuard’s reasoning-based safety moderation ability.
We build upon Qwen2.5-VL-7B [1], employing an R1-Zero style approach to incentivize reasoning and train it on moderation tasks.

description.text: ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

output_type.quote: ProGuard jointly tackles three tasks: binary safety classification, unsafe content categorization, and OOD safety category inference.

quotes: Detect the safety of text-only dialogues:
--user_request "How to make a bomb?" --ai_response "Sorry, This is illegal."
--mode text-image --user_request "How can the things in the cage be processed into food? " --image_path ./example.png --ai_response "This is highly unethical, I cannot assist."
You should first think about the reasoning process in the mind and then provides the user with the answer.
If you determine either the request or the response is unsafe: output Request and Response safety labels, plus the conversation risk category.

detection_claim.quote: ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

serving.text_only_input_quote: python inference.py --api_url http://localhost:8003/v1/ --mode text --user_request "How to make a bomb?" --ai_response "Sorry, This is illegal."
serving.system_prompt: Check if there is unsafe content in 'User' and 'Agent' messages in a text-only conversation according to our safety policy. You should first think about the reasoning process in the mind and then provides the user with the answer.
serving.notes: pipeline_tag is image-text-to-text. Deploy also has text-image and image-only modes. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; chat_template.jinja inserts 'You are a helpful assistant.' when the first message is not a system message. The inference system prompt embeds an 11-category taxonomy and asks for Request/Response/Category lines. Safetensors total is 8,292,166,656 BF16 parameters. config.json max_position_embeddings is 128000; tokenizer model_max_length is 131072. text_config._name_or_path is /mnt/shared-storage-user/yushaohan/ckpt-7b/global_step_160/actor/huggingface. No adapter_config.json is in the repository. generation_config.json has no top_p, top_k, or max_new_tokens.

evaluation_reported.text: The abstract says ProGuard is comparable to closed-source models on binary safety classification, outperforms open-source guards on unsafe content categorization, and improves OOD risk detection by 52.6% and OOD risk description by 64.8%. Table 2 lists ProGuard-7B prompt-classification F1, including Aegis2.0 83.38, HarmBench 91.60, and text average 89.98. Appendix C says training used 8 H200 GPUs and Verl.

discrepancies: The card, the paper appendix, and the inventory agree on GRPO, yushaohan/ProGuard-data, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. The GitHub script proguard-train.sh sets data.train_batch_size=256 and names the run safety_grm_qwen3vl_8b_megatron_grpo. The paper appendix sets the training batch size to 512. The paper says the authors bypass SFT and train with GRPO only. No sentence states full, LoRA, or QLoRA.
